exactCanonicalSetting.sourceObservedSetting: cohort.require_one_esm: Android participant must provide at least one experience-sampling response

inputBoundary: One already-derived nonnegative integer experience-sampling response count per Android participant.
outputBoundary: Exclude a participant with zero responses and retain a participant with at least one response.
limitations: This binding does not identify or deduplicate qualifying experience-sampling responses.
This binding does not group responses or derive participant-level counts.
Android-platform eligibility is a separate upstream source condition, not inferred from the response count.
A missing participant count fails closed rather than being interpreted as zero.
